facility.name: N & C Academy LLC

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 4115 PECAN BLVD, MCALLEN, TX, 78501

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Toilets, Sinks and Fountains Used Safely and Independently: A chair is used by children to climb and drink water from drinking fountain.     CORRECTED at inspection when an age approprtiate step stool was placed for children to use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toilets, Sinks and Fountains Used Safely and Independently (26 TAC §746.4419)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 out of 5 files reviewed were missing a health care professional signed statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Feeding instruction was not avialble for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One classroom observed to not have a caregiver in room to supervise 22  children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present: Observed two caregivers  present in the operation during nap time for 38children, one class with 19 children and another class with no caregiver present with 21 children. Classrooms were not in a centralized area and no additional staff was present in the operation to assists when needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Nap time lighting was not adequate when entering the 2 rooms for nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood: Daily report did not have a section to describe child's mood.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood (26 TAC §746.2431(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Both transportation vehicle's are missing a fire extinguisher and transportation first aid kits are missing a thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last Fire Inspection was conducted on 08/29/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was providing care for 14 children ages 18mo-9yo, SAG 2yo. Classroom was over ratio by 3 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Infant group: one caregiver was providing care for 6 children ages 9-14mo, SAG 0-11mo. Room was over ratio by two children.   Toddler-Prek group: two caregivers were providing care for  17 children ages 17mo-4yo. Age difference between youngest and oldest child exceeded 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: Most recent health inspection was not available for review at the time of inspection. Inspection report provided by completed on 5/22/2023.    Note: A copy of the most recent health inspection report (11/8/2023) was provider by operation via text message after the conclusion of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Five staff files were reviewed. One file is missing annual training certificates and notarized affidavit. A second file is missing translation of foreign diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Six children's records were reviewed, One file is missing up to date immunization records. Six files are missing parent's rights statement. Three files are missing updated special care and water activities statements.     Feeding instructions for five children not yet eating table food were not available for review at the time of inspection.     13 out of the 41 children present were not signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation: Operational Policies were reviewed and the following information is missing:    (a)(21) Procedures for parents to participate in the child-care center's operation and activities;    (a)(22) Procedures for parents to review a copy of the child-care center's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online;    (a)(23) Instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the HHSC website; and     (b)(1) You must inform parents that they may visit the child-care center at any time during your hours of operation to observe their child, the program activities, the building, the premises, and the equipment without having to secure prior approval.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(21))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: There was insufficient light in the toddler room during naptime.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider turned on the light to the adjacent room allowing additional light to enter the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last fire inspection was conducted on 01/21/2022.     Note: Provider contacted the City of McAllen and requested an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads: A child was placed to nap on a play-yard. The play-yard had an additional mat and foam layer which was added on top of the original play-yard mat and covered with a sheet.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider removed additional mat and foam layer and placed a clean sheet on the original play-yard mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: There is mopping bucket containing water in the prek age room and accessible to children.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider removed bucket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: One out of five staff trainings records reviewed was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Two caregivers were providing care for a total of 5 children ages 2mo, 3mo, 8mo, 9mo and 13mo. One of the caregivers stepped out of the room and remained in the kitchen during lunch preparation leaving one caregiver in charge of the 5 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Space Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Does Not Limit Movement: Two children in the toddler room were observied in high chairs while the rest of the group participated in a craft. One child in the prek room was observed a high chair while rest of the group participated in a craft.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Space Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Does Not Limit Movement (26 TAC §746.2603(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One out of five staff records reviewed has an expired first aid/cpr training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One staff file is missing copy high school diploma or equivalent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Two children's files are missing immunization records and three are missing health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One staff member is missing training on Safe Sleep/Shaken Baby/Early Brain Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four staff training records were reviewed. One file is missing 12 clock hours of training including trainings in the following topics:    -Abuse/Neglect  -Hazardous Materials  -Food Allergies  -Administering Medications  -Emergency Preparedness  -Building and Physical Premises Safety  -Communicable Diseases    Two files are missing training on -Safe Sleep/Shaken Baby/Early Brain Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: Per provider a fire inspection was recently conducted, however, inspection report available for review was conducted on 11/6/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Four staff files were reviewed. A file is missing high school diploma. A second files requires a high school diploma be translated into English. Three files are missing copy of ID/DL. One file is missing hired date, affidavit and statements regarding personnel/center policies and orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Six children's files were reviewed. One file was not available for review at the time of inspection. Two files are missing immunization records. Three files are missing health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Operation policies were reviewed and following items are missing:    -Safe Sleep Policy  -Physical and Outdoor Activities Policy  -Abuse/Neglect Policy  -Employee's Vaccinations Policy
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: United States Consumer Product Safety recall list was last certified on 06/19/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: During nap; a child's mat was placed on the hall leading to the playground blocking the emergency exit.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when mat was relocated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: Folder taken during transportation routes is missing the following:    -List of Children Being Transported  -Emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms   -Written Transportation Emergency Plan
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))
